name: Ring of Failed Performance
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ornate ring looks like a ring of inspired performance. Rather than impart a bonus, however, the wearer suffers a -5 penalty to his Perform checks. Additionally, any Perform check that fails by 5 or more is considered to be a total failure and reduces the audience’s attitude by one step.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by casting sculpt sound, upon it, destroying the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of inspired performance

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
